summary: PowerBank Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing it was awarded a $2,950,000 USD federal contract with the US Department of Defense and Department of the Army to construct a solar canopy and EV charging station at a New York Armed Forces Reserve Center. The contract was awarded to its US subsidiary, Abundant Solar Power Inc., following a federal solicitation administered by the US Army Corps of Engineers. This is a routine business development press release disclosing a standard government contract win. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is involved.
